gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patient admitted to neurosurgery department for surgical resection of a suspected high-grade glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: Resection utilizing conventional visual fluorescence-guided surgery.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: In total fifty (n=50) patients referred for resection surgery for suspected high-grade glioma or its recurrence

role_evidence.quote: The patients are prescribed oral 5-ALA preoperatively according to the institution's practices.

coder_notes: Device trial. 5-ALA is not a registered intervention but the arm text states patients are prescribed it for fluorescence-guided surgery; listed as diagnostic_agent. High-grade glioma only; glioblastoma not named in conditions, title, eligibility or arm labels.
